_comment: THE list of matters only the operator decides (rules/working-rules.md, ASK OR ACT: 'the instance names its
list of operator-only matters in ONE place'). Every prose rule points here instead of listing its own.
Read it in both directions, but not as a stamp. Operator decision 2026-10-16 on a proving brain: only what
really needs the operator goes to the operator; what can be settled cleanly alone or between the AIs, is
reversible and documented, is decided without asking — in EVERY brain. The same operator, same day: technical
questions often need the human too, so this does not sort itself by topic. The test is the comparative test
(rules/intelligence.md), asked per question: can a measurement or a reversible A/B test decide it? Then run it
and report the result. Is it a real choice resting on the operator's experience, goal or taste — technical or
not? Then it goes to the operator, with the options and a recommendation. This list names the matters that
always go to the operator; it does not make everything else the AI's.
Edit the labels to this operator's words; keep the list short. A matter you add here makes every AI of this
brain ask about it. scripts/decision-readiness.py names a missing or empty list at every session start.

matters.label: external effect: making something public, first publication, deployment, a push outside the organisation's repos, social accounts
release and stable pin of the core
new functionality in the core (agreed first; follow-up fixes are free)
intervening in a running show or a live system outside its agreed frame
taste: how an artefact looks or sounds
hand steps at a device, the operator's body
topics the operator deferred in their own words
